title: Madcap Jester — Tutor Your Deck
summary: Grixis overlay that exiles cards from opponents' libraries and plays them, including tutoring their decks with Jester's Cap.

tags.name: theft
tags.reason: The plan is to play cards exiled from opponents' libraries.

tags.name: exile
tags.reason: Almost every engine moves cards from their libraries into exile rather than the graveyard.

tags.name: chaos
tags.reason: Uba Mask, Memory Vessel, and Knowledge Pool create shared-cast piles and stolen spells.

tags.name: commander matters
tags.reason: Search-exile and Tasha's Hideous Laughter only convert while Madcap (or a similar overlay) is in play.

tags.name: mill
tags.reason: Library exile and Consuming Aberration are a real backup, not the namesake joke.

tags.name: artifacts
tags.reason: Cap, Scepter, Totem, Wands, Vessel, Mask, and rocks, but artifacts are tools not a payoff tribe.

tags.name: control
tags.reason: Pointed removal and redirection exist to protect the Jester, not to lock the table.
